summary.headline: Planetary Conditions Table
summary.text: Chapter Five explains planetary beneficence and maleficence, masculinity and femininity, diurnal and nocturnal nature, spheres, days, nights, colors, domiciles, detriments, exaltations, falls, apogees, perigees, tastes, and stages of life. A comparative table covers Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon.
